r.summary:
Published BA-04 V4 (JSON + md), BA-02b V4, and a mechanical check with its output. They apply the section 214 decisions (AR3-01..AR3-11, AR3-15, AR3-17, AR3-24, AR3-25, AR3-26, AR3-29, AR3-30) over section 211. The generator is gen_catalog_v4.py, a copy of the V3 generator. It was verified to reproduce V3 byte for byte before editing, and it is deterministic. V3 files and BA-02a V3 are untouched (git diff empty). The check runs 50 checks and all PASS (exit 0). Adversarial mutations were caught: 11 mutated copies each tripped the expected check(s), for example GROUPS_SERVED+SC-B, a removed WU-DRY, a corrupted SEALED_AT, an altered verbatim cell and an EVM pin on a dry run.

Key content:
- **AR3-01 mode.** A CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD, the RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED set and PROVISIONAL_NON_GOVERNING are used by E4-LEARN/LK, HDM-CHAR, all WU-DRY, and also EV-L-* (aligned with BA-06 V4 section 9) and the Q-I14-* vehicles. The last two are open questions.
- **Dry runs.** 157 WU-DRY, one per governing scenario that enters the governed window (the 11 evidence scenarios included), with WU_DRY_RUNS = N_B. Branches that a recorded-not-enforced control would take are the BA-09 V4 residual; no forced branch is used.
- **New and changed scenarios.** New: NC-S5-O6 as ruled, NC-CLONE-REPLACE, CL-CLEAN-FXANNBLANK-FP, HDM-CHAR-*, and EV-L-OC-TM-READ (from BA-06 V4). Changed: the U-*/EA1 fixes, and the X1/SA exact cells.
- **Groups and flags.** Wr-F/G at X5..X7 are in group E8, and SC-B is contract-assigned on every X7 cell. DESIGNED_STIMULUS is added, and CONTRACT_ASSIGNED_GROUPS is kept apart from GROUPS_SERVED.
- **SEALED_AT.** It is the SHA-256 of a canonical serialization: the listed expectation fields, sorted keys, UTF-8, compact separators, no ASCII escaping. The generator computes it and the check recomputes it for all 389 scenarios.
- **Section 7** is reclassified per AR3-26.
- **BA-02b V4.** Section 3 quotes the 29 rows in effect verbatim, checked against the contract files, and uses a per-clause discharge rule. The table has N/A columns for evidence groups and KR, and S5 and E12C are marked as conditional rows.

I wrote BA-07 V4 as a new file; the V3 blob 3a67dd48 is unchanged. It applies AR3-23 in full, plus AR3-22 (pin link) and AR3-25 (pins and BA-11 status live outside BA-11). The V2.1/V2.2/V2.4 clauses it rests on are unchanged.

**Model A**
- The anchor is its own event, ANCHOR_RECORDED (subject ANCHOR, anchor-record hash, anchorRef). There is no ANCHORED event any more; a subject counts as ANCHORED when its last entry index is at most h of a verified anchor.
- IN_USE -> IN_USE is legal. The use preconditions are tied to the anchored approval and pins, not to earlier uses.
- A new baseline version is three consecutive entries in the same log: BASELINE_RECORDED, BASELINE_APPROVED and SUPERSEDED of the previous version. It is then anchored as ct21d-baseline/v<k+1>.

**Verification (6.2)**
- Anchors are discovered at the remote with `git ls-remote --tags 'refs/tags/ct21d-baseline/*'` and fetched into a private namespace.
- baseline-anchor.json and the log are read at each tag's peeled commit, and every anchored index is compared.
- Tags and ANCHOR_RECORDED entries must match one to one.
- The pending window is declared not tamper-evident.
- The independent copy stays at step 6. It reads the designation from INDEPENDENT_COPY, which repeats the one in the BA-07 candidate or ratification record.

**Pins**
- BA-11 holds only the sealed slots. The seal is the Coordinator and Architect ratification pair under ratifications/, cited by PIN_RECORDED.
- The pin machine is RECORDED -> RATIFIED -> ANCHORED.
- The EVM_FROZEN pin record carries inventoryReviewRecords, equal to INVENTORY_REVIEW_RECORDS.

**Serialization**
- JCS (RFC 8785) with a BA-07 profile. Doubles are 16 lowercase hex characters of the binary64 pattern, big-endian, and the encoding is defined inside BA-07. Only safe integers are allowed, all fields are always present (null when not applicable), and a record file is JCS bytes plus one LF.
